verdict.rationale: Cloudflare ships an official command-line tool, Wrangler, for creating, developing, deploying and rolling back Workers. The docs say it fits into GitHub Actions workflows, scoped API tokens are documented, and the API MCP server explicitly supports CI/CD automation by passing an API token as a bearer header. An OpenAPI spec is also published, so the core of headless/CI automation is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive Wrangler auth and flags in CI (e.g. a GitHub Actions deploy recipe), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
